title: Software Developer | Full Stack Developer
summary: Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of professional experience building scalable web applications using React.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and SQL. Experienced in developing responsive, data-driven interfaces, REST APIs, reusable components, role-based systems, real-time features, and performance optimizations. Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions, Nginx, and CI/CD deployments. Strong problem-solving skills with experience taking features from requirements and UI development through backend integration, testing, deployment, and production support.

Developed Node.js REST APIs for CRM workflows, implementing lead allocation, status updates, and role-based business logic.
Automated deployments using GitHub Actions, Docker, and AWS, replacing manual releases with a CI/CD pipeline.

Restructured client state using Redux and RTK Query, eliminating stale-cache issues and improving API data synchronization.
